expeditions.name: Claim Line Shift
expeditions.description: One shift on the canyon claims, swinging at a seam three employers have already written off. Whatever comes out of the hole gets split with the crew, and the crew counts fast.

expeditions.name: Water Haul
expeditions.description: Six drums from the deep cistern up to the rim camps before the heat turns the road to glass. Water is worth more than ore out here, and everybody on that road knows exactly what you are carrying.

expeditions.name: Filter Run
expeditions.description: The canyon-floor garage wants every rig checked before the dust season, which means crawling under twelve of them and arguing with eleven owners. What comes out of the housings is yours to sell.

expeditions.name: Lantern-Walk Survey
expeditions.description: Walk the lantern-walk as far as the third junction and write down whatever the light reaches. The surveyor's chart stops there with a note in the margin, and the note is not a measurement.

expeditions.name: Rig Recovery Circuit
expeditions.description: Three rigs died on the canyon floor this month and the garage wants them stripped before the sand does it for nothing. The mechanic asks you to set aside anything you cannot name — she says the last one was not built anywhere she knows.

expeditions.name: Badlands Writ Service
expeditions.description: Ride out with a bounty writ, a lens that ticks, and a name that has been crossed out and rewritten twice. Serving it is the easy part — the office pays by what you bring back, and half of what you bring back was never the mark's.

expeditions.name: The Claim Nobody Refiled
expeditions.description: The paperwork lapsed nine years ago and nobody has walked down to say why. The shaft is still shored, the lamps are still hung, and the tools are still lying where somebody set them down mid-shift.

expeditions.name: Wreck Field Salvage
expeditions.description: A day in the wreck field under the switchback, where every rig that ever lost an argument with the canyon ended up. Bring shade, bring water, and bring something to carry the good parts out in.

expeditions.name: Dune Road Nightwatch
expeditions.description: Sit the night out with a wagon train on the dune roads, last light to first. The captain wants somebody awake who will not sing back at whatever is singing, and who will sign for whatever the verge gives up before dawn.

expeditions.name: The Procession's Wake
expeditions.description: A whole night and a day digging out a caravan the bride's procession put under, working down through a deck the sand has welded shut. The old hands have one rule about the wake: take the cargo, leave the rings.
